name: RandomTP - Random Teleportation
tagline: Teleports the player to a random location
description:
It can be used in all versions running on Java 8 and above.

Description:​
A plugin that allows you to perform arbitrary teleportation around the world with an unlimited radius from the center of the map. Teleportation is performed to the safe block of the highest point. The plugin provides a time delay between the use of commands, and also allows you to configure teleportation even in other dimensions.


Permissions:​
randomtp.* - All rights under the plugin
randomtp.usage - Allows you to use teleportation
randomtp.bypass- Removes the delay before teleportation
randomtp.reload - Allows you to reload the plugin configuration

Commands:​
/rtp - Randomly teleports the player
  • /randomtp
  • /randomteleport
  • /rteleport
/rtp reload - Reloads the plugin configuration
/rtp [world_name] - Starts searching for a teleport location in the specified world. You can leave it empty, then teleportation will begin in the current world

Code (YAML):
Settings:
  DataBase :
     # Supports MySQL
    type : SQLite
    host : 'localhost'
    port : 3306
    table-name : 'RandomTP'
    user : 'user'
    password : 'password'

  Teleport :
     # The waiting time before the next use of the command
    # Should be specified in seconds
    # You don't need to put spaces!
    ## 1 minute = 60 seconds
    ## 1 hour = 3,600 seconds
    ## 1 day = 86,400 seconds
    ## 1 week = 604,800 seconds
    cooldown : 604800

    # Declination of time
    # Spaces so that there is a separation between word and time
    days : ' day ; day ; days '
    hours : ' hour ; hours ; hours '
    minutes : ' minute ; minutes ; minutes '
    seconds : ' second ; seconds ; seconds '

    # Teleportation at the first appearance in the world
    first-join : false

    # Teleportation at any login to the server
    join : false
    radius : 10000 #Specify only positive numbers

  # List of worlds where random teleportation is available
  # Attention!
  # Don't fit worlds with large voids like world_the_end
  # In the world, world_nether will teleport to the upper thigh
  Worlds :
    - world

  # Blocks that the player does not teleport to
  blacklist-blocks :
    - AIR
    - WATER
    - LAVA

  Messages :
     # Standard colors '&' work
    # Line break %n%
    # Remaining on timer: %timer%
    teleport-start : '&eTeleportation has begun, location search ...'
    teleport-success : '&aYou have been successfully moved! &eOn &c %cord%'
    teleport-wait : '&eExpect more &c %timer%'
    teleport-err-world : '&cError : &eIn this world it is forbidden to use random teleportation'
    not-permission : '&cNot enough rights!'
    not-player-usage : '&cOnly the player can use this command!'
    reload-config : '&aThe configuration has been reload!'

Code (YAML):
Settings:
  DataBase:
    type : SQLite # Поддерживает MySQl
    host : 'localhost'
    port : 3306
    table-name : 'RandomTP'
    user : 'user'
    password : 'password'

  Teleport :
     # Время ожидания перед следующим использованием команды
    # Указывать в секундах
    # Пробелы ставить не нужно!
    ## 1 минута = 60 секунд
    ## 1 час = 3 600 секунд
    ## 1 сутки = 86 400 секунд
    ## 1 неделя = 604 800 секунд
    cooldown : 604800
    # Склонение времени
    # Пробелы для того чтобы было разделение между словом и временем
    days : ' день ; дня ; дней '
    hours : ' час ; часа ; часов '
    minutes : ' минута ; минуты ; минут '
    seconds : ' секунда ; секунды ; секунд '
    # Телепортация при первом появлении в мире
    first-join : false
    # Телепортация при любом входе на сервер
    join : false
    radius : 10000 #Указывать только положительные числа

  # Список миров в которых доступна рандомная телепортация
  # Внимание!
  # Не вписывать миры с большими пустотами, такими как world_the_end
  # В мире world_nether будет телепортировать на верхний бедрок
  Worlds :
    - world

  # Блоки на которые игрока не телепортирует
  blacklist-blocks :
    - AIR
    - WATER
    - LAVA

  Messages :
     # Работают стандартные цвета '&'
    # Перенос строки %n%
    # Остаток на таймере: %timer%
    teleport-start : '&eТелепортация началась, поиск локации ...'
    teleport-success : '&aВы были успешно перемещены! &eНа &c %cord%'
    teleport-wait : '&eОжидайте ещё &c %timer%'
    teleport-err-world : '&cОшибка : &eВ этом мире запрещено использовать рандомную телепортацию'
    not-permission : '&cНедостаточно прав!'
    not-player-usage : '&cТолько игрок может использовать эту команду!'
    reload-config : '&aКонфигурация перезагружена!'

Support database:
  • SQLite
  • MySQL

Metrics:

name: AuthVH
description:
Wiki | Bug tracker | bStats​

No feature bloat — just what a server actually needs, plus a few security things that are usually forgotten:
  • Registration, login, password change, /logout without leaving the server
  • Pre-login protection: no movement, chat, block breaking, combat
  • Tiered lockouts for password guessing — separate counters per account and per IP
  • Account limit per IP, with bypass via permissions
  • Auto-login by session if the player returns from the same IP
  • Automatic database backups and lockdown if the DB goes down
  • Language files, PlaceholderAPI, events for other plugins
  • All messages configurable

Requirements: Spigot / Paper 1.13+, Java 16+. PlaceholderAPI — optional.
Account binding: bound to nickname and UUID

Guide
​


---

---

---

Permissions​

authvh.* — all permissions
authvh.login — login
authvh.register — registration
authvh.changepassword — password change
authvh.admin — all admin commands
authvh.bypass.ip-limit — ignore account limit per IP
authvh.accounts.N — own limit of N accounts

Players get login, register and changepassword permissions by default — no extra setup needed.
Admin commands and bypasses are OP-only by default. If you use a permissions plugin like LuckPerms, make sure the authvh.login, authvh.register, and authvh.changepassword permissions are granted to your default group.
Commands​

  • /register <password> <repeat> — registers a player (aliases: /reg)
  • /login <password> — authorizes the player (aliases: /l)
  • /changepassword <old> <new> — change password (aliases: /changepass, /cpass)
  • /logout — log out without leaving the server
  • /account delete <nick> — delete a player's account
  • /account register <nick> <password> — create an account for a player
  • /account unban <nick | IP> — lift a lockout
  • /account info <nick> — account details
  • /account backup — make a database copy
  • /account reload — reload config (not /reload)
The plugin is in active development. Test on a copy of your server before installing on production.​

name: InfValets - Multi-Currency Economy | Dynamic Exchange Rates | Public API | Vault Support
tagline: Multi-currency economy with dynamic exchange rates, public API and optional Vault support
description:
InfValets
A self-contained multi-currency economy for your server.

Create as many currencies as you like, let players pay and exchange them, and let other plugins use them through a clean public API. No Vault required - but if you have it, InfValets plugs right in.

Supports Minecraft 1.13 - 26.x (Spigot, Paper and forks) | Java 8+ | No dependencies


Features
  • Any number of currencies - each with its own name and its own per-player limit
  • Exchange between currencies with fixed or dynamic exchange rates (see below)
  • Optional exchange fee per pair
  • Pay other players, online or offline
  • Top lists for every currency
  • Paid commands - let players spend a currency to run commands you define in the config
  • Public API for developers, registered through Bukkit's ServicesManager, with custom events
  • Optional Vault support - works with shops, jobs and other plugins that only know Vault
  • Optional PlaceholderAPI support - balances, totals, limits, exchange rates and leaderboards
  • SQLite (built in, zero setup) or PostgreSQL
  • Safe by design - balances can never go negative or above the limit, transfers and exchanges are atomic (all or nothing)
  • Fully configurable messages with colour codes


Dynamic exchange rates
Every exchange pair is configured separately and can be FIXED or DYNAMIC.

FIXED - one constant rate.

DYNAMIC - the rate moves between a minimum and a maximum you choose, depending on two things:
  • How much of the target currency exists - the more of it is in circulation (compared to the "normal" amount you set), the cheaper it gets, so players receive more of it per unit.
  • How often players exchange into it - frequent exchanges into a currency make it more expensive, so players receive less of it. The time window and the "normal" number of operations are configurable.
Both effects have their own sensitivity and can be switched off independently. The plugin also warns you in the console if two opposite pairs would let players earn money by exchanging back and forth.

Code (YAML):

Convert:
  fee-percent : 0
  pairs:
    coin-gems:
      mode : FIXED
      rate : 10               # 1 coin = 10 gems
    gems-coin:
      mode : DYNAMIC
      rate : 0.09             # base rate
      min-rate : 0.05
      max-rate : 0.1
      fee-percent : 1
      supply:
        reference : 1000000   # "normal" total amount of the target currency
        sensitivity : 0.5
      demand:
        window-minutes : 60
        reference-ops : 20     # "normal" number of exchanges per window
        sensitivity : 0.5
 


Commands
If you only have one currency, the currency argument can be left out.
  • /balance (aliases /bal, /money) - your balances
  • /balance <currency> - your balance in one currency
  • /balance <player> [currency] - another player's balance
  • /balance top [currency], /baltop [currency] - leaderboard
  • /pay <player> [currency] <amount> - send money to a player
  • /convert <from> <to> <amount> (aliases /exchange, /conv) - exchange currencies
  • /convert rate [from] [to] - show current exchange rates
  • /costcommands <name> (aliases /paycmd, /payc) - run a paid command from the config
  • /eco give|take|set <player> [currency] <amount> (alias /economy) - admin tools
  • /eco reset <player> [currency] - set a balance to zero
  • /infvalets reload (alias /ivalets) - reload the config


Permissions
  • infvalets.balance - own balance and leaderboards (default: everyone)
  • infvalets.balance.others - other players' balances (default: operators)
  • infvalets.pay - /pay (default: everyone)
  • infvalets.convert - /convert (default: everyone)
  • infvalets.costcommands - /costcommands (default: everyone)
  • infvalets.admin - /eco, /infvalets reload and the admin subcommands of /balance (default: operators)


PlaceholderAPI
Identifier: infvalets. Values are cached and refreshed in the background, so they never block the server thread.
  • %infvalets_balance_<currency>% and %infvalets_balance_formatted_<currency>%
  • %infvalets_limit_<currency>%
  • %infvalets_total_<currency>% - how much of a currency all players own together
  • %infvalets_rate_<from>_<to>% - current exchange rate
  • %infvalets_top_<currency>_<1-10>_name% and _balance% - leaderboard places


Vault
Vault is not required. If it is installed, InfValets registers itself as an economy provider for one currency of your choice (set in the Vault section of the config), so shops, jobs and similar plugins work out of the box.
Limitations: bank accounts are not supported, and amounts must be whole numbers.


For developers
InfValets has its own public API (no Vault needed) with multi-currency support, atomic operations and cancellable events. It never throws exceptions at you and is safe to call from async tasks.

Code (Java):

InfValetsAPI api = InfValetsAPI. get ( ) ;   // null if InfValets isn't running
if (api == null ) return ;
 
long coins = api. getBalance (player, "coin" ) ;
 
TransactionResult result = api. withdraw (player, "coin", 100 ) ;
if (result. isSuccess ( ) ) {
    // give the item
}
 
ConversionResult exchange = api. convert (uuid, name, "coin", "gems", 50 ) ;
 

Events: ValetTransactionEvent (before a change, cancellable) and ValetBalanceChangedEvent (after a change).

Full documentation: API documentation on GitHub


Installation
  1. Drop InfValets.jar into your plugins folder and start the server.
  2. Edit plugins/InfValets/config.yml: define your currencies, exchange pairs and messages.
  3. Run /infvalets reload to apply changes.
SQLite is used by default. For PostgreSQL, set the connection string in the Database section (the PostgreSQL driver is downloaded automatically on 1.16.5 and newer; on older servers use SQLite). Changing the database connection requires a restart.


Good to know
  • Balances are whole numbers.
  • Exchange history is stored for 30 days and is only used to calculate dynamic rates.
  • This plugin uses bStats to collect anonymous usage statistics. You can opt out in plugins/bStats/config.yml.


Support
Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue here: issue tracker - or leave a message in the discussion tab. A review is always appreciated!

name: SkinPatchVH
tagline: Set and restore player skins by nickname. Paper & Velocity in a single jar.
description:
SkinPatchVH
Skins by nickname. One jar for Paper and Velocity.​

About
SkinPatchVH restores a player's skin by nickname and lets players pick any skin with a single command. Skins are downloaded directly from Mojang, cached in memory and saved, so a player's choice is applied again on every login.

Features
  • Automatically applies the skin of the player's nickname when the profile has no textures
  • /skin <nickname> - use the skin of any player
  • /skin reset - go back to the skin of your own nickname
  • The chosen skin is remembered between sessions
  • Tab completion for online players
  • Fully asynchronous: skin downloads never block the server
  • One jar works on Paper (and forks) and on Velocity

Commands & permissions
  • /skin <nickname> - set a skin (permission: skinpatchvh.use, granted to everyone by default)
  • /skin reset - reset your skin

Requirements
  • Paper (and forks such as Purpur), Spigot or CraftBukkit 1.18 or newer, or Velocity 3.x
  • Java 17 or newer
  • Folia and BungeeCord are not supported

Installation
  1. Put SkinPatchVH.jar into the plugins folder of your Paper server or your Velocity proxy.
  2. Restart the server.
  3. Players can use /skin right away.
Install it in one place only: either on the proxy or on a standalone server, not on both the proxy and the backend servers behind it.

Good to know
  • Paper (recommended): the new skin is applied immediately.
  • Spigot: other players see the new skin immediately, you will see it after rejoining. On some very recent builds Spigot does not allow editing player profiles - in that case the skin is saved and applied on the next join. Use Paper or Velocity there for full support.
  • Velocity: a skin cannot be changed while the player is connected, so it is applied the next time the player joins.
  • Chosen skins are stored in plugins/SkinPatchVH/skins.json.
  • Skins are requested from the Mojang API; if Mojang is unreachable or rate-limits requests, the player is asked to try again later.
Data collection & update checker
  • The plugin uses bStats to collect anonymous usage statistics (server software, plugin version, player count). You can disable it in plugins/bStats/config.yml.
  • The plugin checks for new versions through the SpigotMC API every 12 hours and notifies players with the skinpatchvh.update permission (operators by default). Disable it by setting "update-checker" to false in plugins/SkinPatchVH/config.json.
  • Skins are requested from the Mojang API.

Support
Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue here: issue tracker - or leave a message in the discussion tab. A review is always appreciated!
